orientation_target: identity hand-link orientation relative to current torso (palms inward)
description: Closed-loop kinematic diagnostic: recorded pelvis, legs, waist and world targets; arm position-and-orientation DLS IK recomputed from previous replay arm state each frame. q_hold captured once at seven seconds without applying a posture correction. No persistent reference accumulation, physics integration, or policy execution. Damping 0.05, per-joint increment cap 0.05 rad, soft-limit factor 0.9, one solve per recorded control frame.
